source.name: Sevilleta LTER small mammal mark-recapture core research sites
source.documented_design: 8 sites, 3 radial trapping webs per site, 3 consecutive nights in spring and fall, 145 stakes/web
source.source_intended_scope: Independent multi-site, multi-genus structural candidate. Radial-web geometry is NOT NEON square-grid 10x10; never numerically pool unstandardized spatial slopes.

additional_source_access.EDI_PASTA_API_public_access_as_of_2026_0: EDI requires authenticated API access for REST endpoints; no key was supplied/used.

scientific_decision.next_step: Obtain authorized official EDI dataset access and immutable entity checksum plus stake-to-XY mapping before any individual-level SEV8 test. Do not infer geometry from vague spokes/stakes description.
